verses.text: Di word of di Lord wey come to Micah di Morashtite for di days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, wey e see about Samaria and Jerusalem.
Hear, una peoples, all of una! Listen, earth, and everything wey dey inside am! Make di Lord God be witness against una, Lord from im holy temple.
Because look, di Lord dey come out from im place, and e go come down and tread on di high places of di earth.
Di mountains dey melt under am, and di valleys dey split apart like wax before di fire, like waters wey dem pour down steep slope.
All dis na because of Jacob disobedience, and because of di sins of di house of Israel. Wetin be Jacob disobedience? No be Samaria? Wetin be di high places of Judah? No be Jerusalem?
So I go make Samaria like heap of rubble for di field, like places wey dem dey plant vineyards; and I go pour im stones down inside di valley, and I go uncover im foundations.

Dem go beat all im engraved images to pieces, and all im wages go burn with fire, and I go lay all im idols desolate; because from di wages of prostitute e don gather dem, and to di wages of prostitute dem go return.
Because of dis I go lament and wail. I go dey naked and without cloth. I go make wailing like di jackals, and mourning like di ostriches.
Because im wounds no get cure; because e don reach Judah. E reach my people gate, even Jerusalem.
No tell am for Gath. No weep at all. For Beth Ophrah I don roll myself for di dust.
Pass on, you wey dey live for Shaphir, naked and with shame. Di one wey dey live for Zaanan never come out. Di wailing of Beth Ezel go take im protection from you.
Because di one wey dey live for Maroth dey wait with worry for good, because evil don come down from di Lord reach di gate of Jerusalem.
Tie di chariot to di fast horse, you wey dey live for Lachish. E na di beginning of sin to Zion daughter, because dem find Israel transgressions inside you.
So you go give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. Di houses of Achzib go be deceitful thing to di kings of Israel.
I go still bring to you, you wey dey live for Mareshah, di one wey go possess you. Di glory of Israel go come reach Adullam.
Make your head bald, and cut off your hair because of your delight pikin dem. Make your baldness wide like di vulture; because dem don go into captivity from you.
Woe dey for dem wey dey plan iniquity and dey do evil for dem beds! When morning light come, dem dey do am, because e dey inside di power of dem hand.
Dem dey covet fields, and seize dem; and houses, and carry dem go. Dem dey take man house from am, and man heritage from am.
So di Lord talk say, “Look, I dey plan disaster against dis family, wey una no go fit remove una necks from, and una no go walk with pride; because e go be evil time.”

“For dat day dem go take up parable against una, and lament with sorrowful lamentation, and talk say, ‘We don ruin completely! E dey change my people portion! See how e dey remove am from me! To di rebellious e dey share our fields.’”
So you no go get anybody wey go throw di line by lot for di assembly of di Lord.
“No prophesy!” dem dey prophesy. “Dem no go prophesy to dem. Disgrace no go overtake us.”
You wey dem call Jacob house, di Lord don lose patience? Na im doings be dis? My words no dey do good to di one wey dey walk without blame?
But just now my people don rise up like enemy. You dey take di robe from di garment of dem wey dey pass without care, like men wey no like war.
You dey drive di women of my people out from dem pleasant houses. From dem young pikin dem you dey take my glory forever.
Rise, and leave! Because dis no be your resting place, because of uncleanness wey dey destroy, even with painful destruction.
If man wey dey walk inside spirit of falsehood dey lie, e talk say, “I go prophesy to una about wine and strong drink,” e go be di prophet of dis people.
I go surely gather una, Jacob, all of una. I go surely gather di remnant of Israel. I go put dem together like di sheep of Bozrah, like flock inside dem pasture. Dem go full with plenty people.
Di one wey break open di way dey go up before dem. Dem break through di gate, and come out. Dem king dey pass on before dem, di Lord dey di head of dem.
I talk say, “I beg una, listen, una heads of Jacob, and rulers of di house of Israel: no be for una to know justice?”
“Una wey hate wetin good, and love wetin evil; wey tear off dem skin from dem body, and dem flesh from dem bones;”
“Wey also chop di flesh of my people, and strip dem skin off dem, and dem break dem bones, yes, dem cut dem into pieces, like meat for pot, and like flesh inside cauldron.”
Den dem go cry to di Lord, but e no go answer dem. Yes, e go hide im face from dem for dat time, because dem make dem deeds evil.

Dis na wetin di Lord talk about di prophets wey dey lead my people astray; wey dey bite with dem teeth, and dey cry “Peace!” and anybody wey no put am inside dem mouths, dem dey prepare war against am:
“So night go come for una, so that una no go get vision; and e go dark for una, so that una no fit do divination; and di sun go set over di prophets, and di day go black over dem.”
“Di seers go dey ashamed, and di diviners go dey confused. Yes, dem all go cover dem lips; because answer no dey from God.”
But as for me, I dey full with power by di Lord Spirit, and with justice, and with might, to declare to Jacob im disobedience, and to Israel im sin.
I beg una, hear dis, una heads of di house of Jacob, and rulers of di house of Israel, wey hate justice, and dey twist all fairness.
Dem dey build Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

Im heads dey judge for bribes, and im priests dey teach for pay, and im prophets dey tell fortunes for money; yet dem dey lean on di Lord, and talk say, “Di Lord no dey among us? No disaster go come on us.”
So because of una, dem go plow Zion like field, and Jerusalem go become heaps of rubble, and di temple mountain go be like di high places of forest.
But for di last days, e go happen say dem go establish di mountain of di Lord house for di top of di mountains, and dem go raise am up above di hills; and peoples go dey flow go am.

Plenty nations go come and talk say, “Come, make we go up to di mountain of di Lord, and to di house of di God of Jacob; and e go teach us im ways, and we go walk for im paths.” Because di law go come out from Zion, and di word of di Lord from Jerusalem;

And e go judge between plenty peoples, and go decide about strong nations wey dey far away: and dem go beat dem swords into plowshares, and dem spears into pruning hooks. Nation no go lift sword against nation, and dem no go learn war again.
But dem go sit, every man, under im vine and under im fig tree; and nobody go make dem afraid: because di mouth of di Lord of Armies don talk.
Because all di peoples dey walk for di name of dem own god, and we go walk for di name of di Lord our God forever and ever.
“For dat day,” na so di Lord talk, “I go gather di lame ones, and I go gather di ones wey dem don drive away, and di ones wey I don make suffer;”
“And I go make di lame ones remnant, and di ones wey dem throw far away strong nation: and di Lord go reign over dem for Mount Zion from dat time forward, even forever.”
“You, tower of di flock, di hill of Zion daughter, to you e go come, yes, di former dominion go come, di kingdom of Jerusalem daughter.”
Now why you dey cry out loud? King no dey inside you? Your counselor don perish, so that pains don hold you like woman wey dey give birth?

Feel pain, and struggle to give birth, Zion daughter, like woman wey dey give birth; because now you go leave di city, and go live for di field, and go reach Babylon. For dat place dem go rescue you. For dat place di Lord go redeem you from di hand of your enemies.
Now plenty nations don gather against you, wey dey talk say, “Make dem defile am, and make our eye gloat over Zion.”
But dem no know di thoughts of di Lord, and dem no understand im counsel; because e don gather dem like sheaves to di threshing floor.

“Rise and thresh, Zion daughter; because I go make your horn iron, and I go make your hoofs bronze; and you go beat plenty peoples to pieces. You go dedicate dem gain to di Lord, and dem wealth to Lord of di whole earth.”
Now you go gather yourself for troops, troops daughter: e don lay siege against us; dem go strike di judge of Israel with rod for di cheek.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, wey small among di clans of Judah, from you one go come out to me wey go be ruler for Israel; wey im goings out dey from old, from ancient times.
So e go abandon dem until di time wey di woman wey dey give birth don give birth. Den di rest of im brothers go return to Israel pikin dem.
E go stand, and shepherd dem for di strength of di Lord, for di majesty of di name of di Lord im God: and dem go live, because now e go be great reach di ends of di earth.
Dis one go be our peace when Assyria invade our land, and when e march pass our fortresses, den we go raise seven shepherds against am, and eight leaders of men.
Dem go rule di land of Assyria with sword, and di land of Nimrod for im gates: and e go save us from di Assyrian, when e invade our land, and when e march enter our border.
Di remnant of Jacob go dey among plenty peoples like dew from di Lord, like showers for di grass, wey no dey wait for anybody, and no dey wait for di sons of men.

Di remnant of Jacob go dey among di nations, among plenty peoples, like lion among di animals of di forest, like young lion among flocks of sheep; wey, if e pass through, e go tread down and tear in pieces, and nobody go dey to save.
Make your hand rise up above your adversaries, and make dem cut off all your enemies.
“E go happen for dat day,” na so di Lord talk, “say I go cut off your horses from among you, and go destroy your chariots;”
“And I go cut off di cities of your land, and go tear down all your strongholds.”
“I go cut off witchcraft from your hand; and you no go get soothsayers again.”
“I go cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you no go worship di work of your hands again.”
“I go pluck your Asherah poles from among you; and I go destroy your cities.”
“I go carry out vengeance with anger and wrath on di nations wey no listen.”
Hear now wetin di Lord talk: “Rise, plead your case before di mountains, and make di hills hear your voice.”
Hear, una mountains, di controversy of di Lord, and una enduring foundations of di earth; because di Lord get controversy with im people, and e go contend with Israel.
My people, wetin I do to you? How I tire you? Testify against me.
Because I bring you up from di land of Egypt, and redeem you from di house of bondage; and I send Moses, Aaron and Miriam before you.
My people, remember now wetin Balak king of Moab plan, and wetin Balaam, Beor pikin, answer am from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you go know di righteous acts of di Lord.
How I go come before di Lord, and bow before di high God? I go come before am with burnt offerings, with calves wey be one year old?
Di Lord go dey pleased with thousands of rams, with tens of thousands of rivers of oil? I go give my first pikin for my disobedience, di fruit of my body for di sin of my soul?
E don show you, man, wetin good. Wetin di Lord require from you, except to do wetin just, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
Di Lord voice dey call di city, and wisdom dey see your name: “Listen to di rod, and di one wey appoint am.”
“E still get treasures of wickedness for di house of di wicked, and short measure wey dem curse?”
“I go dey pure with wicked scales, and with bag of deceitful weights?”
“Because di rich men of di city dey full of violence, and di people wey dey live inside am don talk lies, and dem tongue dey deceitful inside dem mouth.”
“So I too don make you sick by striking you. I don make you desolate because of your sins.”
“You go eat, but you no go dey satisfied. Your humiliation go dey among you. You go move am, but you no go save am; and wetin you save I go give to di sword.”
“You go sow, but you no go reap. You go tread di olives, but you no go anoint yourself with oil; and you go crush grapes, but you no go drink di wine.”

“Because dem dey keep Omri statutes, and all di works of Ahab house, and you dey walk inside dem counsels, so that I go make you desolation, and di people wey dey live inside am hissing. You go carry di reproach of my people.”
Woe dey for me! Because I dey like di gathering of summer fruit, like di grape gleanings. Cluster no dey to eat. My soul dey desire di first ripe fig.
Di godly man don perish from di earth, and nobody wey upright dey among men. Dem all dey lie in wait for blood. Each one dey hunt im brother with net.
Dem hands dey on wetin evil to do am carefully. Di prince ask, and di judge ready for bribe. Di great man talk out wetin im soul desire. So dem dey conspire together.
Di best among dem be like briar. Di most upright worse pass thorn hedge. Di day of your watchmen, your visitation, don come. Now na di time of dem confusion.
No trust neighbor. No put confidence for friend. Guard di doors of your mouth from di one wey dey lie for your bosom.
Because di son dey dishonor im papa. Di daughter dey rise up against im mama. Di daughter-in-law against im mother-in-law. Man enemies na di men for im own house.
But as for me, I go look to di Lord. I go wait for di God of my salvation. My God go hear me.
No rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I go rise. When I sit for darkness, di Lord go be light to me.
I go bear di Lord anger, because I don sin against am, until e plead my case, and do judgment for me. E go bring me out to di light. I go see im righteousness.
Den my enemy go see am, and shame go cover di one wey talk say to me, “Wia di Lord your God dey?” My eyes go see am. Now dem go tread am down like di mud of di streets.
Na day for di building of your walls! For dat day, di boundary go far reach.
For dat day dem go come to you from Assyria and di cities of Egypt, and from Egypt reach di River, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
Still di land go be desolate because of dem wey dey live inside am, for di fruit of dem doings.
Shepherd your people with your staff, di flock of your heritage, wey dey live alone for forest, inside Carmel. Make dem graze for Bashan and Gilead, as for di days of old.
“As for di days of your coming out from di land of Egypt, I go show dem marvelous things.”
Di nations go see and dem go dey ashamed of all dem might. Dem go put dem hand for dem mouth. Dem ears go deaf.
Dem go lick di dust like serpent. Like creeping things of di earth dem go come out from dem dens dey tremble. Dem go come with fear to di Lord our God, and dem go dey afraid because of you.
Who be God like you, wey dey pardon iniquity, and pass over di disobedience of di remnant of im heritage? E no dey keep im anger forever, because e dey delight for loving kindness.
E go again get compassion for us. E go tread our iniquities under foot. You go throw all dem sins inside di depths of di sea.
You go give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you don swear to our papa dem from di days of old.
